{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true prices, showing significant lag that increases with forecast horizon",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price momentum - high sentiment predicts continued price increases",
    "The forecast bias is most pronounced in the first 10-day horizon, narrowing in later periods as prices converge to historical means",
    "When current price deviates far from model forecast, correction towards history means is more aggressive than model predicts",
    "Sentiment turning negative early predicts more rapid price correction than the model's gradual decay suggests",
    "Model under-forecasts price peaks by approximately 3-5% in the first 15-day window",
    "When sentiment becomes strongly positive (≥0.67), model needs 20-30% more bullish bias to avoid significant valuation gap"
